outcome: Connive draws a card then discards a card, and the permanent gets a +1/+1 counter if the discarded card is nonland.
A permanent that left the battlefield still connives, using last known information.
Simultaneous connives happen one at a time, in APNAP order of the permanents' controllers.
Connive N draws N, discards N, and adds counters equal to the number of nonland cards discarded.
Connive 0 is no event and connive triggers do not fire.
A permanent connives, firing connive triggers, even if some of the actions were impossible.
